correctness.rationale: In standard UT3 coordinates the induced translation by k has i-row phase zeta^(s k_x(i_y-k_y)). Commuting with it forces the row-k kernel coefficients a_(i-k) with the inverse phase, as in the frozen formula; the output commutant's basepoint row is arbitrary. Dualizing via the invariant pointwise pairing identifies H_s* with H_(-s) and expresses a channel as the diagonal trilinear tensor with independent commutants in its three slots. Thus permutation of the central triple preserves the variety up to linear equivalence. The automorphism (x,y,z) -> (lambda x,y,lambda z) gives the scaling symmetry. The triples split into all zero (1 pair), one zero (18), nonzero with a repeated entry (18), and nonzero with all distinct entries (12, represented by 1,2,4). The 2-dimensional scaling fiber bounds the affine one-channel dimension by 145, hence sixteen have dimension at most 2320 < 2401. Independent NumPy construction, indexed by derivative coordinates, and exact byte-valued F8 elimination reproduced all four rank-2401 minors, their pivot hashes and residues 1,6,6,1. The root of order seven defines reduction from Z[zeta_7] to F8; nonzero residues imply nonzero complex determinants at the integral lifts. Surjective complex differentials imply dominance. Constructibility and removal of the proper sixteen-channel closure yield actual width 17 on a nonempty open set, not just border width.
residual_risks: Neither exceptional-target nor worst-case widths are established. The computation is a characteristic-zero nonvanishing certificate, not a description of characteristic-two secant geometry.
